profile.name: DHAMODHARAN R
profile.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
profile.bio: I am a motivated Computer Science student currently learning Full Stack Development, with practical experience in IoT-based projects like smart monitoring systems. I enjoy building innovative solutions that combine software and hardware to solve real-world challenges. I am eager to apply my skills and continuously learn new technologies.

projects.title: Nivora – Smart Intelligent Mountain Road Safety System
projects.description: Developed an IoT-based system to detect vehicles at blind curves and reduce accident risks. Implemented real-time bidirectional alerts for approaching vehicles, integrated emergency SOS feature with GPS for accident situations, and designed fail-safe mechanisms for communication and power failures.

projects.title: Zerora – Advanced Water Monitoring & Automatic Cleaning System
projects.description: Built a smart system to monitor water quality using pH, turbidity, and TDS sensors. Implemented real-time detection of contaminants and unsafe conditions, designed automatic cleaning mechanism to flush and refill contaminated water, and integrated alert system for notifying users about water quality issues.

projects.title: InOrOut – Real-Time Smart Faculty Availability & Notification System
projects.description: Developed a system to track faculty availability using real-time entry/exit sensor detection. Implemented sensor-based monitoring to update status automatically, designed notification system to inform students about faculty presence, and improved communication efficiency within the institution.

projects.title: Digilog – Digital Student Monitoring System
projects.description: Developed a digital system to monitor and manage student activity records. Replaced manual tracking with automated data logging, designed structured data storage for easy retrieval and analysis, and improved accuracy and efficiency in monitoring processes.

projects.title: CSENEXUS – Department Coordination Website
projects.description: Developed a web platform for managing departmental activities and communication. Designed user-friendly interface for announcements and updates, structured content for easy access by students and faculty, and improved coordination and information sharing within the department.
